column3: Global mean sea level change due to thermal expansion for CMIP6 models and observations relative to the baseline period (1850-1900)
Data is for the black, brown, grey, blue and green lines and shadings in Figure 3.29 in the IPCC Working Group I Contribution to the Sixth Assessment Report: Chapter 3
Global Mean Sea Level Anomalies (GMSLA) is computed from CMIP6 simulations and observations
It is monthly data provided as the fraction of a year
Global Mean Sea Level Anomalies (GMSLA) mean is computed from CMIP6 simulations with anthropogenic and natural forcings (historical)
Global Mean Sea Level Anomalies (GMSLA) 95 percentile is computed from CMIP6 simulations with anthropogenic and natural forcings (historical)
Global Mean Sea Level Anomalies (GMSLA) 5 percentile is computed from CMIP6 simulations with anthropogenic and natural forcings (historical)
Global Mean Sea Level Anomalies (GMSLA) mean is computed from CMIP6 simulations with anthropogenic greenhouse gases forcings (hist-GHG)
Global Mean Sea Level Anomalies (GMSLA) 95 percentile is computed from CMIP6 simulations with anthropogenic greenhouse gases forcings (hist-GHG)
Global Mean Sea Level Anomalies (GMSLA) 5 percentile is computed from CMIP6 simulations with anthropogenic greenhouse gases forcings (hist-GHG)
Global Mean Sea Level Anomalies (GMSLA) mean is computed from CMIP6 simulations with anthropogenic aerosol forcings (hist-aer)
Global Mean Sea Level Anomalies (GMSLA) 95 percentile  is computed from CMIP6 simulations with anthropogenic aerosol forcings (hist-aer)
Global Mean Sea Level Anomalies (GMSLA) 5 percentile  is computed from CMIP6 simulations with anthropogenic aerosol forcings (hist-aer)
Global Mean Sea Level Anomalies (GMSLA) mean is computed from CMIP6 simulations with natural forcings only (hist-nat)
Global Mean Sea Level Anomalies (GMSLA) 95 percentile is computed from CMIP6 simulations with natural forcings only (hist-nat)
Global Mean Sea Level Anomalies (GMSLA) 5 percentile is computed from CMIP6 simulations with natural forcings only (hist-nat)
Global Mean Sea Level Anomalies (GMSLA) mean is computed from observations from Section 2.3.3.1 of the AR6 WGI
Global Mean Sea Level Anomalies (GMSLA) 95 percentile is computed from observations from Section 2.3.3.1 of the AR6 WGI
Global Mean Sea Level Anomalies (GMSLA) 5 percentile  is computed from Section 2.3.3.1 of the AR6 WGI
